scope: Two original nonflat SU(2) configurations of the retained gauge-invariant three-plaquette test function. Independent finite right-flow derivatives check the component scalar weighted operator against the full one-form Hessian expression. Connection signs and all diagonal/mixed curl blocks are checked. These are universal algebra/derivative diagnostics, not an actual Yang–Mills vacuum computation.
